You gotta do what you gotta do.
Compared to the other things I've had to adjust to in my life? Not really.
Kind of? But I've enjoyed it.
PapaPolar: song of the soldier, right there. from what i can gather from the rest of the happy lil band 'o freaks, you got sucked into entrati's nonsense same as us.
PapaPolar: haha sounds like it, if the crazy stories i've heard from our happy lil band 'o freaks are even half true.
PapaPolar: oh yeah? why?
PapaPolar: if for real different reasons.

I like having a place with walls and windows for a change. And not a ship.
The company. It's nice to feel like I belong somewhere for once.
The food.
How'd you wind up getting mixed up with Entrati?
I assume you came here looking for Rusalka and found Entrati instead?
PapaPolar: yet here we are.
PapaPolar: yeah, can't imagine i'd fit well on one of those lil space ships of yours

PapaPolar: arrived to this mess somewhere early 1998, so before you arrived. neci refused to see us. couldn't get anywhere NEAR her, even
PapaPolar: yep. arrived to this mess somewhere early 1998, so before you arrived. neci refused to see us. couldn't get anywhere NEAR her, even
PapaPolar: gives me the heebies just thinking about it.

PapaPolar: anyway, i'll let you get back to it.
PapaPolar: y'know, that's what this stupid bar is missing. real food. i should build a smoker out of some of the extra oil drums we've got kicking around. you'll LOVE it

MomToxicated: I have a good instinct for things like this.

Yeah. Yeah, I think I do.
The what?
And Entrati had just the injection for it.
MomToxicated: Mmhm. Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.
MomToxicated: Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.
MomToxicated: Techrot, darling.

MomToxicated: He told us, quite bluntly, what it would do to us. Offered us the choice.
MomToxicated: No, he very conveniently left that part out. And by the time we recovered from our... treatment... you had arrived to Höllvania.
MomToxicated: And you know how things went from there.

Well... I'm glad you're here.
